name: BlackRock — Student of the Market
description: BlackRock's monthly market-commentary chart deck for financial advisors, published as a downloadable PDF (plus a video and a customizable presentation deck) reviewing current market and economic trends against historical patterns. Used here as a design/framing reference for how a large asset manager frames a monthly market-conditions chart pack.

notes: The monthly PDF and video are viewable/downloadable from the advisor-facing page without login.

A "Brand & Share Tool" that lets advisors customize the presentation deck with their own branding requires login to BlackRock's Advisor Center; that customization step is not needed to view or download the base PDF.
